notes: Oracle's Java Language Specification, Java SE 17 -> Java SE 21. This annotation records one complete, source-reviewed semantic addition in the pattern-definition section; the remaining edition changes are outside the reviewed scope. The quote is normalized by collapsing PDF line wrapping, and its source mask covers the complete inserted sentence.

old.end_quote: A type pattern is used to test whether a value is an instance of the type appearing in the pattern.

new.end_quote: A record pattern is used to test whether a value is an instance of a record class type and, if it is, to recursively perform pattern matching on the record component values.

changes.new_quote: A record pattern is used to test whether a value is an instance of a record class type and, if it is, to recursively perform pattern matching on the record component values.
changes.note: Java SE 21 adds record patterns to the pattern grammar and defines their recursive matching behavior. The sentence appears on PDF page 573 (printed page 557); the corresponding Java SE 17 section has no record-pattern definition.
